body_markdown:
We are excited to announce that we will be attending the Consensus 2023 conference in Austin, Texas, from April 26 to 28. The conference is one of the largest events in the blockchain and cryptocurrency industry, bringing together thought leaders, entrepreneurs, and developers to discuss the latest trends and innovations in the space.


As part of the conference, our COO, Nicolas Roussy Newton, will be a guest speaker on the "Problem Solvers: CoinDesk Projects to Watch" panel on Friday, April 28 at 10:00 AM CDT on The Hash Stage at the Austin Convention Center. The panel will focus on key problems that the community is addressing, including privacy, scalability, security, viability, climate change, and financial inclusion. Nicolas will share insights on BTQs approach to securing mission-critical networks, and discuss the progress we have made in developing our solutions.


At the conference, we will also be meeting with other industry leaders and stakeholders to discuss the latest developments in the blockchain and cryptocurrency space, and explore potential collaborations and partnerships.


For more information on the "Problem Solvers: CoinDesk Projects to Watch" panel and the conference agenda, please visit the event page at[https://consensus.coindesk.com/agenda/event/-problem-solvers-coindesk-projects-to-watch-100](https://consensus.coindesk.com/agenda/event/-problem-solvers-coindesk-projects-to-watch-100) .


We look forward to a productive and inspiring event, and hope to see you there!
